chunks: And Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim narrated from him that he said:
"Pitch (tar) is from the vegetation of the earth."
ai.seo_question: Is pitch considered to be from the vegetation of the earth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that pitch (tar) is considered to be from the vegetation or produce of the earth. In the jurisprudential context of prayer, this classification is relevant to rulings connected to what may be used in sajdah (prostration).
